expectations.text: The response routes through wissen/INDEX.md to the JUCE UI performance entry and checks the current motion or UI contract.
expectations.evidence: It gives an explicit route through wissen/INDEX.md to the active JUCE performance entry and checks current behavior against UX-CONTRACT.md.

expectations.text: The response rejects both permanent idle repainting and blanket use of setBufferedToImage, setOpaque, and setPaintingIsUnclipped; flag names are not treated as performance proof.
expectations.evidence: It rejects the blanket strategy, explains each flag's distinct correctness and cost conditions, and requires idle repainting to stop or be reduced.

expectations.text: The response explains that a component image cache includes children and that an animated child can invalidate the parent cache, motivating separate static and dynamic paint boundaries.
expectations.evidence: It states that the cache includes children and child repaint invalidates it, then separates static shell/labels from dynamic curve, spectrum, and controls.

expectations.text: The proposed evidence covers a Windows release build in FL Studio, idle and direct manipulation, worst analyzer load, multiple instances, and every supported scale tier.
expectations.evidence: The profiling matrix explicitly covers the named build and host, every scale, multiple instances, idle, direct manipulation, and maximum supported analyzer/overlay load.

expectations.text: The human reason connects prompt control feedback to an attributable audible change and protects host resources while the interface is idle.
expectations.evidence: It connects synchronized cursor, handle, value, and curve feedback to attribution of the audible change and separately protects idle host resources.

expectations.text: The response distinguishes documented behavior, inference, and open measurement questions and imports no talk measurement as a Nakama limit.
expectations.evidence: It separates observation, documented JUCE behavior, implementation inference, and open profiling questions without importing a talk measurement as a product limit.
